datasets.name: Bijie landslide detection database
datasets.verbatim: For this research work, we employed the Bijie landslide detection database (Ji et al. 2020), a popular dataset developed to support the research on landslide detection using remote sensing images.

datasets.name: HR-GLDD (High-Resolution PlanetScope images)
datasets.verbatim: First, the prevalent benchmark dataset used for evaluation, HR-GLDD, comprises high- resolution PlanetScope images (Meena et al. 2023).

methods.name: Multi-Layer Attention Boosted YOLOv10 Network
methods.summary: An improved YOLOv10 network that integrates attention modules (CBAM, ECA, GAM, and SA) discretely within the neck of the architecture to enhance feature representation and landslide detection accuracy.

availability.author_statement: The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are referenced but not linked, and the custom code for the Multi-Layer Attention Boosted YOLOv10 Network is not provided or linked.
